package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type publicationRepositoryStub struct {
	item *domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication
}

func (stub *publicationRepositoryStub) CreatePendingPublication(_ context.Context, publication domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication) error {
	copy := publication
	stub.item = &copy
	return nil
}

func (stub *publicationRepositoryStub) GetPublicationByProjectID(_ context.Context, projectID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication, error) {
	if stub.item == nil || stub.item.StudentPracticeTaskID != projectID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := *stub.item
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub *publicationRepositoryStub) GetPublicationBySlug(_ context.Context, slug string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication, error) {
	if stub.item == nil || stub.item.ShareSlug != slug || stub.item.Status != domain.PracticeTaskPublicationStatusReady ||
		stub.item.Visibility == domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPrivate {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	copy := *stub.item
	return &copy, nil
}

func (stub *publicationRepositoryStub) ListPublicationsByStudentID(_ context.Context, studentID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication, error) {
	if stub.item == nil || stub.item.StudentID != studentID || stub.item.Visibility != domain.PracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityPublic {
		return []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication{}, nil
	}
	return []domain.StudentPracticeTaskPublication{*stub.item}, nil
}

func (stub *publicationRepositoryStub) MarkPublicationReady(_ context.Context, publicationID string, visibility int16, publishedAt *time.Time, updatedAt time.Time) error {
	if stub.item == nil || stub.item.ID != publicationID || stub.item.Status != domain.PracticeTaskPublicationStatusPending {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	stub.item.Status = domain.PracticeTaskPublicationStatusReady
	stub.item.Visibility = visibility
	stub.item.PublishedAt = publishedAt
	stub.item.UpdatedAt = updatedAt
	return nil
}

func (stub *publicationRepositoryStub) UpdatePublicationVisibility(_ context.Context, publicationID string, visibility int16, publishedAt *time.Time, updatedAt time.Time) error {
	if stub.item == nil || stub.item.ID != publicationID || stub.item.Status != domain.PracticeTaskPublicationStatusReady {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	stub.item.Visibility = visibility
	stub.item.PublishedAt = publishedAt
	stub.item.UpdatedAt = updatedAt
	return nil
}

type publicationFileStorageStub struct {
	source    []byte
	public    []byte
	uploaded  bool
	activated bool
	sourceID  string
	publicID  string
}

func (stub *publicationFileStorageStub) DownloadSourceArchive(_ context.Context, fileID string) ([]byte, error) {
	stub.sourceID = fileID
	if fileID == "approved-artifact-file" {
		return append([]byte(nil), stub.source...), nil
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *publicationFileStorageStub) DownloadPublicationSnapshot(_ context.Context, fileID string) ([]byte, error) {
	stub.publicID = fileID
	if fileID == "public-snapshot-file" {
		return append([]byte(nil), stub.public...), nil
	}
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (stub *publicationFileStorageStub) UploadTemporaryArchive(_ context.Context, ownerID, filename string, content []byte) (string, error) {
	if ownerID != "student-1" || !strings.HasSuffix(filename, ".snapshot") {
		return "", errors.New("unexpected upload metadata")
	}
	stub.uploaded = true
	stub.public = append([]byte(nil), content...)
	return "public-snapshot-file", nil
}

func (stub *publicationFileStorageStub) Activate(_ context.Context, fileID string) error {
	if fileID != "public-snapshot-file" {
		return errors.New("unexpected activation")
	}
	stub.activated = true
	return nil
}

func TestPracticeTaskPublicationUsesApprovedArtifactAndNeverExposesStorageOrSandbox(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, projectRepository := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	artifactID := "approved-artifact"
	projectRepository.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted
	projectRepository.project.CompletedAt = &now
	projectRepository.artifacts = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact{{
		ID: artifactID, StudentPracticeTaskID: projectRepository.project.ID, StorageFileID: "approved-artifact-file",
	}}
	projectRepository.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID: "review-1", StudentPracticeTaskID: projectRepository.project.ID, ArtifactID: &artifactID,
		Status: domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPassed, MentorStatus: domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPassed,
		ReviewedAt: &now,
	}}
	catalog := useCase.Catalog.(finalReviewCatalogStub)
	catalog.runtime.RevisionNumber = 7
	catalog.runtime.PracticeTask.Title = "Storefront Lite"
	catalog.runtime.PracticeTask.Theme = "Product catalog"
	catalog.runtime.SolutionVariants[0].Code = "html-css-js"
	catalog.runtime.SolutionVariants[0].Title = "HTML + CSS + JavaScript"
	catalog.runtime.SolutionVariants[0].Topology = "frontend_only"
	catalog.runtime.SolutionVariants[0].StackCodes = []string{"html", "css", "javascript"}
	catalog.runtime.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].Title = "Visible product catalog"
	catalog.runtime.PracticeTaskMilestones[0].StackCodes = []string{"html", "css", "javascript"}
	useCase.Catalog = catalog
	publicationRepository := &publicationRepositoryStub{}
	fileStorage := &publicationFileStorageStub{source: publicationTestZip(t, map[string]string{
		"index.html": "<h1>Storefront Lite</h1>",
		"app.js":     `document.querySelector("h1")`,
		".env":       "TOKEN=must-not-leak",
	})}
	useCase.Publications = publicationRepository
	useCase.PublicationFiles = fileStorage

	ownerView, err := useCase.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(context.Background(), "student-1", projectRepository.project.ID, "unlisted")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("publish completed practice task: %v", err)
	}
	if !fileStorage.uploaded || !fileStorage.activated || fileStorage.sourceID != "approved-artifact-file" {
		t.Fatalf("expected approved artifact -> sanitized upload -> activation, got %#v", fileStorage)
	}
	if ownerView.Visibility != "unlisted" || ownerView.SecurityReport == nil || ownerView.Manifest.ExcludedFilesCount != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected owner publication view: %#v", ownerView)
	}

	publicView, err := useCase.GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication(context.Background(), ownerView.ShareSlug)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("get unlisted publication by link: %v", err)
	}
	if len(publicView.Files) != 2 || publicView.SecurityReport != nil {
		t.Fatalf("public view must contain safe code without private scan paths: %#v", publicView)
	}
	if fileStorage.publicID != "public-snapshot-file" {
		t.Fatalf("expected encrypted publication snapshot download, got %#v", fileStorage)
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(publicView)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal public view: %v", err)
	}
	forbiddenValues := []string{"approved-artifact-file", "public-snapshot-file", "sandbox-1", "must-not-leak", ".env", ownerView.ID}
	for _, forbidden := range forbiddenValues {
		if strings.Contains(string(payload), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("public response leaked %q: %s", forbidden, payload)
		}
	}
}

func TestPracticeTaskPublicationVisibilityRevokesAndListsCorrectly(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, projectRepository := publicationReadyUseCase(t)
	view, err := useCase.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(context.Background(), "student-1", projectRepository.project.ID, "public")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("publish: %v", err)
	}
	items, err := useCase.ListPublicPracticeTaskPublications(context.Background(), "student-1")
	if err != nil || len(items) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("public profile must list publication: items=%#v err=%v", items, err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(context.Background(), "student-1", projectRepository.project.ID, "private"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("make private: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication(context.Background(), view.ShareSlug); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("private publication link must be revoked, got %v", err)
	}
	items, err = useCase.ListPublicPracticeTaskPublications(context.Background(), "student-1")
	if err != nil || len(items) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("private publication must disappear from profile: items=%#v err=%v", items, err)
	}
}

func TestPracticeTaskPublicationRequiresMentorApprovedCompletion(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, projectRepository := publicationReadyUseCase(t)
	projectRepository.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusInReview
	_, err := useCase.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(context.Background(), "student-1", projectRepository.project.ID, "public")
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrInvalidStatus) {
		t.Fatalf("expected completed-project requirement, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestPracticeTaskPublicationCanAlwaysBeRevokedAfterCreation(t *testing.T) {
	useCase, projectRepository := publicationReadyUseCase(t)
	view, err := useCase.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(context.Background(), "student-1", projectRepository.project.ID, "unlisted")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("publish: %v", err)
	}
	projectRepository.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusChangesRequested
	if _, err := useCase.SetPracticeTaskPublicationVisibility(context.Background(), "student-1", projectRepository.project.ID, "private"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("revocation must not depend on a later project status: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := useCase.GetPublicPracticeTaskPublication(context.Background(), view.ShareSlug); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("revoked publication must not remain readable, got %v", err)
	}
}

func publicationReadyUseCase(t *testing.T) (StudentUseCase, *finalReviewRepositoryStub) {
	t.Helper()
	useCase, repositoryStub := newFinalReviewTestUseCase(nil)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	artifactID := "artifact-1"
	repositoryStub.project.Status = domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusCompleted
	repositoryStub.project.CompletedAt = &now
	repositoryStub.artifacts[0].ID = artifactID
	repositoryStub.artifacts[0].StorageFileID = "approved-artifact-file"
	repositoryStub.reviews = []domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview{{
		ID: "review-1", StudentPracticeTaskID: repositoryStub.project.ID, ArtifactID: &artifactID,
		Status: domain.PracticeTaskFinalReviewStatusPassed, MentorStatus: domain.PracticeTaskMentorReviewStatusPassed,
		ReviewedAt: &now,
	}}
	useCase.Publications = &publicationRepositoryStub{}
	useCase.PublicationFiles = &publicationFileStorageStub{source: publicationTestZip(t, map[string]string{"main.go": "package main"})}
	return useCase, repositoryStub
}
